title: Stoa Validation Contract
description: A machine-readable contract of stable, cross-layer business validation rules (Validation Trace IDs), supplied by the user of Stoa for the project under analysis via `stoa analyze --contracts <file>`. It describes the EXPECTED business rule; it is not proof that the rule is correctly implemented or executed at runtime — see docs/*/implementation-status.md.

version.description: Contract version, for change tracking; not tied to Stoa's own engine/ruleset versions.

id.description: Stable Validation Trace ID, e.g. VC-ITEM-QUANTITY-001. A project-chosen prefix, not a Stoa-reserved namespace — never confuse with Stoa's own R-* rule ids or finding:/fact: ids.

field.description: The business field or data group this rule governs (documentation only — not used to auto-match code by name).

integer.description: Whether the value must be a whole number (Zod .int()).

allowedValues.description: A fixed, enumerated set of allowed string values (Zod z.enum([...])). Compared as a set, order-independent.

layers.description: Which layers this rule applies to. Its presence alone is NOT proof: when it includes "backend", Stoa additionally checks whether an annotated implementation of this id could actually be ATTRIBUTED to the backend (found fed by request-handling data, not merely declared) — see R-VALIDATION-CONTRACT-LAYER-UNRESOLVED. "frontend" is accepted but never checked (no positive frontend-attribution signal exists yet).

securityRequirements.description: Free-text notes on backend-authoritative/security expectations; not machine-checked. See `security` for the structured, partially machine-checked equivalent.

security.description: Structured backend security requirements. Stoa is honest about what it can and cannot statically prove here: only `serverSideValidation` has a real static signal (the same backend-attribution evidence as `layers: ["backend"]`, see R-VALIDATION-CONTRACT-SECURITY-UNVERIFIED). The other five flags describe requirements Stoa's current fact model has no way to verify (no session/auth/tenant modeling exists) — declaring them is accepted and schema-validated, but produces no finding either way; absence of a finding is NOT confirmation they are met.

serverSideValidation.description: Checked via the same backend-attribution evidence as `layers: ["backend"]`.

massAssignmentProtection.description: Not statically verified by Stoa (no reliable per-id correlation to R-VALIDATION-MASS-ASSIGNMENT exists yet).

version.description: Per-rule version, for tracking changes to this one business rule independent of the whole contract's version.
